edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff’s First Requests for Production. The provisions below govern production and privilege logging but do not substitute for a separate response to each request. Nothing in these responses extends any earlier deadline imposed by applicable law, court order, or agreement.

1. REQUEST-SPECIFIC RESPONSES AND OBJECTIONS. Defendant will provide a separate response to each request stating whether production will be made as requested. Each objection will identify its specific legal and factual basis, the portion of the request to which it applies, and whether responsive materials are being withheld on that basis. If an objection applies only in part, the response will identify the limitation applied and Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged materials within the unobjectionable portion. No general objection will operate as an unstated basis for withholding responsive material.

2. PRODUCTION. Defendant will begin rolling production of responsive, non-privileged documents within its possession, custody, or control within 14 days after service of these revised responses and complete production within 30 days after service, subject to any earlier applicable deadline. Production will be organized and labeled to correspond to the requests or made as documents are kept in the usual course of business, as permitted by applicable rules. Any anticipated inability to meet a deadline will be promptly disclosed with the reason and a proposed resolution; such notice does not extend the deadline.

3. PRIVILEGE LOG. For responsive materials withheld or redacted on grounds of attorney-client privilege, work-product protection, or another applicable protection, Defendant will expressly identify the protection asserted and provide a log sufficient to permit assessment of each claim without revealing protected information. Unless applicable rules, a court order, or an agreement permit otherwise, the log will identify the request implicated, document date and type, author, recipients and their roles, a non-privileged description of the subject matter, the protection asserted and its basis, and whether the material is withheld in full or redacted. The log will accompany final production, subject to any earlier applicable deadline.

4. SUPPLEMENTATION AND RIGHTS. Defendant will supplement its responses and production as required by applicable rules or court order. This provision does not reserve unspecified objections or authorize withholding without disclosure. Nothing in these responses waives any earlier applicable deadline or Plaintiff’s right to challenge an objection, seek production, contest a privilege claim, or seek other relief.
